name: input-form
title: Input form
description: Type numbers into a cube — one unit at a time (a store, a cost centre…), rows down, periods across — with save checks, working together, history and an optional spread action.

settings.heading: The title at the top of the screen
settings.subtitle: One line under the title
settings.version: { dimension, member } — the version they type into (optional)
settings.fixed: { dimension: member } — other dimensions held at one member (e.g. a currency)
settings.unit: { dimension, level, label } — what people pick: the elements at that level they can see (e.g. stores)
settings.period: { dimension, members, label } — e.g. years to choose from (optional)
settings.rows: { dimension, under, label } — the leaf elements under this element, down the side
settings.columns: { dimension, members, total } — across the top; total is shown, not typed
settings.spread: { process, unit, period, row, total } — optional 'spread a total' action: the process and its parameter names
settings.reservations: { process, unit, period, mode } — optional editing locks (mode auto = only when the cube requires them)
settings.writes: The cubes it may change — normally just the cube
settings.runs: The processes it may run — the spread and reservation processes, if any

example.heading: Expense input
example.subtitle: Operating expenses · type into the white cells, then Save
